title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Toyota Automated Logistics is seeking a Software Engineer Intern to join their team for Summer 2027.

The Software Engineer Intern will work with Toyota Automated Logistics’ R&D team in Indianapolis, IN to help produce industry leading Autonomous Vehicle and Robotic solutions for the Material Handling Industry. With a current team size of approximately 40 members, the Indianapolis R&D team is composed of a group of industry leading experts with cross-discipline skillsets and backgrounds. The Software Engineer Intern will work alongside like-minded engineers in an Agile development environment and will have the opportunity to engage in every stage of the R&D process. This includes research, innovation, design, and prototype development to successfully bring new products to market.

The Software Engineer Intern will work alongside a dedicated mentor to assist in development of our core software architecture as well as applied software solutions. This position will have ample opportunity to learn from team members, as well as to have ownership of focused projects and designs.

Job Functions

Work alongside dedicated mentor on Intern projects
Develop and test software for Autonomous Vehicles and Robots
Participate in design reviews and code reviews
Assist in testing of live Autonomous Vehicles and Robots
Engage in Agile development processes to plan sprints and team workloads
Follow GitFlow processes for robust version control

Travel Requirements

5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Toyota Automated Logistic)
Travel is for training purposes

Preferred Skills And Required Qualifications

Must be eligible to work in the USA long term without sponsorship.
Undergrad or Graduate Program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or similar field
C++ and Python experience
Experience with Git version control
Comfortable using and developing in a Linux (Ubuntu) OS environment
ROS (Robot Operating System) familiarity a plus
Experience with hardware (microcontrollers, motor control, sensors, etc) a plus
Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls.

About Toyota Automated Logistics

Toyota Automated Logistics is your global partner for integrated warehouse automation. Our team combines the talents of Bastian Solutions, Vanderlande’s warehousing business and viastore under one brand to deliver scalable systems, intelligent software and life-cycle services.

In addition to exciting work at a growing company, we offer the following benefits:

Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match
Vacation / Holiday Pay
Paid Volunteer time off
Tuition Reimbursement
Professional Associations, Conferences and Subscriptions
Company Meetings & Events

Toyota Automated Logistics does not work with outside recruiting agencies. No solicitation phone calls please.
